topic: A crying young fan who thought Jaylen Brown was traded gets surprised by meeting him in real life.

script: When this young fan found out his favorite player was traded, he burst into tears. As he would leave this message for his favorite player, Jaylen Brown. However after this video went viral, it got the attention of Jaylen Brown who left a comment, and just a couple days later, he would surprise his biggest fan, meeting him in real life.
